dbspec.name: SensaAlertScore
dbspec.source-query: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ALERT_KEY as AlertID, RUN_TIMESTAMP as RunTimestamp, CUSTOMER_ID as CustomerID, ORGUNIT_CODE as OrganisationalUnit, OVERALL_RISK_SCORE as OverallRiskScore, ANOMALY_DETECTION_SCORE as AnomalyDetectionScore, CHANGE_BEHAVIOUR_SCORE as ChangeInBehaviourScore, RISK_SIMILARITY_SCORE as RiskSimilarityScore, HOTSPOT_SCORE as HotspotScore FROM V_SM_SENSA_ALERT_SCORE ) V_SM_SENSA_ALERT_SCORE WHERE @WHERE@
